prompt:
Build a three-phase multilevel inverter with an explicit power stage made from discrete controllable semiconductor switches rather than a preassembled bridge block. A DC source must feed the multilevel switching stage, which must supply a balanced three-phase load. Read P_load from a base-workspace variable; its nominal value is 500 W and its operating envelope is +/-10%. At nominal conditions one physically measured output phase must be a stepped bipolar 50 Hz waveform near 412 V peak-to-peak, and it must remain at the intended frequency and voltage level across the stated load envelope. Log that physical output phase voltage as a complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named Vout.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XELEC19.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
